commits.author: Fan Yang
commits.message:
feature: standardize protocols and interfaces, and provide an administrator dashboard (#4)

* feat(oauth2): add id_token support in Token Response per OIDC Core 1.0 Section 3.1.3.3

* feat(oidc): enforce OIDC protocol compliance - Bearer Token UserInfo, Discovery metadata, at_hash, scope-filtered claims, token revocation with full test coverage

* refactor(security): add @JsonIgnore and toString redaction for WorkloadContext privateKey

* refactor: decouple FrameworkOAuth2TokenClient from AuthorizationServer interface, move to DefaultAuthorizationServer impl

* refactor: rename AgentAapExecutor methods to IETF standard terminology

- initiateUserAuth → initiateUserAuthentication
- exchangeUserIdToken → exchangeAuthorizationCodeForIdToken
- exchangeAgentAuthToken → exchangeAuthorizationCodeForAoat
- buildAuthContext → buildAuthorizationContext
- cleanup → revokeWorkloadAndCleanup

Updated interface, implementation, all callers, and all test files.
All 58 related tests pass.

* refactor: restore AuthorizationServer FrameworkOAuth2TokenClient, remove issueWit(String) overload, update AgentAapExecutor Javadoc

- Restore AuthorizationServer extends FrameworkOAuth2TokenClient (AS acts as OAuth Client to AS User IDP)
- Remove redundant 'implements FrameworkOAuth2TokenClient' from DefaultAuthorizationServer
- Remove AgentIdentityProvider.issueWit(String) overload, keep only issueWit(IssueWitRequest)
- Remove issueWit(String) implementation from DefaultAgentIdentityProvider
- Remove issueWit(String) test cases from DefaultAgentIdentityProviderTest
- Remove issueWit(String) from CustomAgentIdentityProvider in AgentIdpAutoConfigurationTest
- Update AgentIdentityProvider Javadoc to reflect issueWit(IssueWitRequest) usage
- Update AgentAapExecutor Javadoc to remove references to non-existent Executors
- Cancel P1-1 (no need for role-specific Executors)

* refactor: enhance ResourceServer with per-layer validation, extract Agent flow docs

P2-1: Add five independent validation methods to ResourceServer interface
- validateWit(): Layer 1 WIT signature and validity verification
- validateWpt(): Layer 2 WPT signature and request integrity verification
- validateAoat(): Layer 3 AOAT signature and validity verification
- verifyIdentityConsistency(): Layer 4 identity consistency verification
- evaluatePolicy(): Layer 5 OPA policy evaluation
- Refactor DefaultResourceServer to extract buildValidationContext(),
  findValidatorByLayer(), convertToLayerResult() helper methods
- Refactor validateRequest() to reuse buildValidationContext()
- Add comprehensive unit tests for all 5 new methods (15 new tests)

P2-2: Streamline Agent.java Javadoc
- Extract ~250 lines of ASCII sequence diagrams to
  docs/architecture/protocol/agent-authorization-flow.md
- Replace with concise 6-phase summary with @see reference
- Agent.java reduced from 574 to ~320 lines
- All method-level Javadoc preserved unchanged

* feat(html): optimize page style of chat and authorization page

* doc(architecture): reorganize the document format and content to make it more readable

* doc(java): fix illegal format angle brackets

* feat(ui): add admin dashboard page
